items.headline: Dorgu suffers hamstring injury on international duty for Denmark
items.summary: Manchester United defender Patrick Dorgu was forced off after 30 minutes during Denmark's Nations League match, adding to mounting injury concerns during international break.

items.headline: Man United draw 1-1 with Fulham amid performance criticism
items.summary: Manchester United drew 1-1 with Fulham on Sunday with late Matheus Cunha equaliser. Gary Neville criticised the performance severely, calling a spell the worst in 50 years.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel wants to leave Manchester United for Chelsea
items.summary: Teenage academy prospect JJ Gabriel has informed United he wants to leave, with Chelsea emerging as target club. Gabriel's family reportedly critical of United's standing.

items.headline: United sign academy prospect Isaac Konde from Liverpool
items.summary: Manchester United completed signing of teenage academy forward Isaac Konde from Liverpool youth ranks.

items.headline: United raid Man City for second wonderkid in one week
items.summary: Manchester United confirmed signing of second academy prospect from Manchester City in seven days, following David Eze joining after Karim Cassim.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko misses Fulham match with recurring shin problem
items.summary: Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko absent from Fulham game due to persistent shin injury. Manager Michael Carrick expressed concern over player's availability.
